# Volume 4 timeline

## CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS

**[Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md), [Gideon Duckett](../character/gideon-duckett.md), [Gorham Pullen](../character/gorham-pullen.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Duckett](../character/isolde-duckett.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Small Nell Lucinda](../character/small-nell-lucinda.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md)** — In the attic at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Isolde Duckett](../character/isolde-duckett.md) chat about Nell's upcoming marriage to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) and her move to [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor). They reflect on their past, Isolde's young daughter [Small Nell Lucinda](../character/small-nell-lucinda.md), and the local gossips of [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P6](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016)_

## CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Gorham Pullen](../character/gorham-pullen.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — At [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) excitedly prepare gifts for Nell's upcoming wedding to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md). Visitors come to congratulate [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), including [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), Mrs. [Gorham Pullen](../character/gorham-pullen.md), and Mrs. Jasper Bell, who offer mixed well-wishes. Later, Hugh visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and they joyfully discuss the historic house in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) he has secured for them to live in.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P0](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P9](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P15](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P20](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0020)_

## CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discusses her upcoming wedding plans and guest list with Mrs. Sowerby and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). Visitors arrive at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to celebrate, including [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), Mother [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), and [Reverend Ez](../character/ezra.md). After visiting Obed's grave in solitude, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) takes a walk and meets Hugh on the eve of their wedding.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P0](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P57](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0057)_

## CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREY SHUTTERS

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Gideon Duckett](../character/gideon-duckett.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Duckett](../character/isolde-duckett.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Small Nell Lucinda](../character/small-nell-lucinda.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md)** — On her wedding morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reflects warmly on her youth at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) while family and friends gather to prepare for the event. Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are married by Mr. [Wace](../character/wace.md) in the sunlit orchard surrounded by loved ones. After a joyous celebration, the newlyweds leave for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Agnes](../codex/places.md#agnes), leaving [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and the guests behind.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREY SHUTTERS P0](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREY SHUTTERS P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREY SHUTTERS P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREY SHUTTERS P17](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0017)_

## CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING

**[Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) ride in a buggy toward their new house near [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor). Along the way, they admire the landscape, pass a gaudy neighbor's house, and spot a strikingly beautiful girl herding geese before arriving at their home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING P18](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING P19](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0019)_

## CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL

**[Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh settle into their new dwelling where [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), Mrs. Doctor Dave, and Captain Saul welcome them over a evening supper. During the meal, Captain Saul shares stories about his kindness to a stray dog and provides details about their nearby neighbors.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P16](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P28](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0028)_

## CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

**[Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md)** — Gathered by the hearth, Captain Saul recounts the history of the house and its original owners, the schoolmaster [John Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md) and his bride [Damaris Leigh](../character/damaris-leigh.md). He tells how [Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md) foresaw her safe arrival aboard the [Royal William](../codex/tech.md#royal-william) after a long delay, after which the town welcomed her and celebrated their wedding.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P0](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P34](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045)_

**[Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md)** — Captain Saul shares memories of the house's past inhabitants and chats with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about the moon and kindred spirits. The guests take their leave, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh to walk through their moonlit garden together in happiness.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P60](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0060), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P64](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0064)_

## CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL

**[Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh reflect happily on their flawless honeymoon in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), where Hugh shares his pride in saving a patient's life overnight. Miss Winifred [Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) arrives to pay a visit while sewing a baby gown, keeping [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and an eavesdropping Hugh entertained with her straightforward and opinionated commentary on neighbors, men, and church denominations.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P1](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P9](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P37](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0037)_

**[Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — Miss Winifred [Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) converses with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), sharing her frank and sharp opinions on men, local ministers, and village acquaintances like Captain Saul and [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md). After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) asks her to stay for tea, Miss Winifred reveals she knew Hugh was secretly listening to her comments from the adjoining room.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P39](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0039), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P57](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0057), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P71](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0071), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P79](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0079)_

## CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT

**[Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh walk down to [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) light, passing a strange bearded man on the way. They visit Captain Saul at the lighthouse, where he shows them the lights and machinery and serves them tea. Over tea, Captain Saul explains that the man they saw was [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md), who vowed not to cut his hair or beard until the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) party won an election.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P19](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)_

**[Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Joe Mott](../character/joe-mott.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md)** — Captain Saul shares stories about how he rescued his cat, [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), and confronted the owner who abandoned it. He then shows [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh his collection of curiosities and captivating tales from his life at sea. As they prepare to leave, [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) reflects on his yearning for adventure and his past companions before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh walk home discussing him.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P49](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P57](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0057)_

## CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE

**[Gog](../character/gog.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes for a walk along the shore after a storm and encounters her neighbor [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md). The two strike up a conversation, introduce themselves, and discuss their lives and mutual friends before parting ways. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later returns home and shares her impressions of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) with Hugh.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P9](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P58](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0058)_

## CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — Miss Winifred tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) the tragic history of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) Vane's family, including the deaths of her brother and father, and how she was coerced into marrying [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P11](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)_

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — Miss Winifred recounts the tragedy of [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md) losing his memory and intellect after a trip to [Havana](../codex/places.md#havana), leaving [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) to care for him as a child for eleven years. Moved by the tragic story, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) promises to do everything she can to be a friend to [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P39](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0039), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042)_

## CHAPTER 12 LORNA COMES OVER

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh at the house of dreams, where she relaxes and enjoys fudge, conversation, and their collection of books. Before leaving, she promises to return, though her demeanor turns cold and somber upon realizing what she lacks in life. Afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh discuss Lorna's beauty and affirm their love for each other.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 12 LORNA COMES OVER P0](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LORNA COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LORNA COMES OVER P13](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LORNA COMES OVER P21](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0021)_

## CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Gog](../character/gog.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks through a foggy night to visit [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), but retreats upon seeing [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) weeping bitterly inside her home. Outside, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) encounters Captain Saul [Garrick](../character/uncle-saul.md) and [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md), and Captain Saul walks her back home while discussing [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and the nature of the foggy darkness.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P0](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P5](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P19](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0019)_

## CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS

**[First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh spend autumn evenings at the lighthouse with Captain Saul and [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), engaging in conversations and listening to stories. Walking home together afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh affectionately discuss Lorna's potential, their own happiness, and their shared home as they look forward to spring.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P2](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P6](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P7](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P16](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0016)_

## CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS

**[Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their home in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), Captain Saul, and [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) in attendance. During the visit, Miss Winifred and Captain Saul exchange lively, opinionated stories and debates about local gossip, church politics, and historical feuds while Hugh entertains them. After Hugh carefully carves the geese under Nell's instructions, the group enjoys a successful feast and listens to Captain Saul's tales by the fire.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P7](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053)_

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — In the kitchen, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reprimands Hugh and Captain Saul for baiting [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) before instructing Hugh to carve the geese. Hugh carves the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) meal successfully, and the group enjoys a festive dinner followed by storytelling by the hearth. Afterward, Captain Saul prepares to head back to the lighthouse and invites [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to visit him.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P48](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P49](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P54](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0054)_

## CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT

**[Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Joe Mott](../character/joe-mott.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Hugh, and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) walk to [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point) lighthouse on New Year's Eve, catching a rare glimpse of Venus's shadow along the way. At the lighthouse, they gather with Captain Saul and [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md), who entertains everyone with songs and dances a wild, exhilarating dance with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). As midnight strikes, Captain Saul opens the door to welcome the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) and offers a hopeful toast to all present.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021)_

## CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Isolde Duckett](../character/isolde-duckett.md), [Joe Mott](../character/joe-mott.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md), Twin Sailors, [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — During a cold winter at [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends time with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and Captain Saul, though she senses an underlying distance and resentment from [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) despite their friendship. After [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) reacts bitterly to news of Nell's upcoming child, she later gifts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) a delicately handmade baby gown. Meanwhile, Captain Saul shares his written life log with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who wishes a talented writer like [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) could turn his adventurous life into a book.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P11](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P12](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P19](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0019)_

## CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS

Captain Saul borders Nell's garden beds with shells, and the group engages in lively conversation and banter about theology, local gossip, and neighbors.

## CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK

**[Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) comes to stay at the house to help [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) during her pregnancy and labor. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gives birth to a baby girl, whom she names [Joyce](../character/joyce.md), but the baby dies shortly after birth, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh devastated. The community grieves with them as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) slowly recovers while mourning her loss.

## CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET

**[Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md)** — Hugh takes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point), where she sits with Captain Saul by the rocks. Captain Saul comforts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over her grief regarding [Joyce](../character/joyce.md) and tells her the story of his long-lost love, [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), asking [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to remember her and pass on her story.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P1](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P6](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P8](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P16](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0016)_

## CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY

**[Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — Sitting in Nell's garden, [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) confesses her past feelings of intense envy and hatred toward [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), explaining how her difficult life and past tragedies caused her bitterness. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reassures [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and forgives her, cementing a deeper, genuine friendship between the two women.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P1](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P5](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P11](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P29](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0029)_

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) declares her deep friendship for [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) as they stand beneath the birch trees at sunset. Holding hands, both women share a tearful smile, cementing their bond as lifelong friends.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P47](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0047), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P48](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P49](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0049)_

Later, Miss Winifred and Captain Saul visit, conversing about village locals and announcing that a young journalist named [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) will soon be staying with [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md).

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) introduces Adrian to the area, walks him over to his new lodging at the Vane house, and watches as he is struck by [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) Vane's striking beauty.

**[Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) introduces [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) to Captain Saul at [Seven Gulls Point](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-point), where [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) realizes Adrian is the grandson of Damaris [Tremayne](../character/john-tremayne.md). [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) shares colorful stories of his sea-faring past and lends Adrian his treasured life-book to read.

## CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK

**[Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), Carrows, [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md)** — [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) agrees to write Captain Saul's life story incorporating the tale of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and he spends a glorious summer working on the manuscript at the lighthouse. Along with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Hugh, [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), and [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), Adrian enjoys coastal outings while finishing the novel, which he concludes by September.

## CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION

**[Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) confesses to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) his deep, secret love for [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), agonizing over the fact that he must leave her forever without acting on his feelings. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) listens empathetically and agrees to write to him with news of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), until Miss Winifred arrives and breaks the somber mood with her pragmatic comments.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P9](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P25](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0025)_

## CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) waits on the foggy sandbar while Hugh goes to the fishing cove and encounters a distressed [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) walking alone. [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) confesses to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that she has secretly fallen in love with [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) and is heartbroken by his cold departure. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) comforts her and keeps Adrian's feelings secret, before Hugh returns to take them both home.

## CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

**[Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), Carrows, Ducketts, [Fiske](../character/fiske.md), Glen, [Henry](../character/henry.md), [Leavitt](../character/leavitt.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Maria](../character/maria.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — Miss Winifred and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chat over the newspaper obituaries and past parish stories, including a story about an overzealous evangelist named [Fiske](../character/fiske.md). [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) mourns the death of her loyal old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), refusing Nell's offer of a replacement for now. After spending [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh return to [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), where Captain Saul shares news from [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) about his upcoming book publication.

## CHAPTER 29 HUGH AND NELL DISAGREE

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Gog](../character/gog.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — Hugh discusses with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) his belief that an operation could restore Rufus Vane's sanity and memory, arguing that it is his medical duty to inform [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) strongly opposes the idea, arguing that telling [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) would unfairly burden her and ruin her life, though Hugh remains firm in his conviction.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 29 HUGH AND NELL DISAGREE P10](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 29 HUGH AND NELL DISAGREE P12](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 29 HUGH AND NELL DISAGREE P15](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 29 HUGH AND NELL DISAGREE P16](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0016)_

## CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES

**[Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visit Captain Saul, who agrees that [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) must be informed about Rufus Vane's possible recovery. Hugh then tells [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), who decides to take Rufus to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for surgery despite her shock. Later, [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) angrily confronts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over the decision, though she ultimately accepts that [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) has made up her mind.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P4](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P22](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P32](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P40](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0040)_

## CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) secures funds from Captain Saul and travels to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with Hugh and Rufus for the surgery. After returning home, Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receive a letter from [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) with a shocking revelation: the man they believed to be Rufus for twelve years is actually his cousin, [Laurence Vane](../character/laurence.md), while the real Rufus died in Cuba long ago.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P8](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)_

## CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) discuss the shocking news about Rufus Vane's death and [Laurence](../character/laurence.md) Vane's regained memory, which frees [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). Miss Winifred recalls the similarities between the cousins and expresses relief for [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), while hinting that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) should inform [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) of Lorna's freedom.

**[Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md) returns home and visits [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in her garden. [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) pours out her grief, confusion, and exhaustion regarding [Laurence](../character/laurence.md) Vane's identity recovery and her past struggles, while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) offers quiet comfort and reassurance.

## CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, bringing deep comfort to her and Hugh after their earlier loss. Friends and family gather to admire the newborn, whom they decide to name [James Obed](../character/james-obed.md). Afterward, [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) plans to visit [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), bringing up hopes for Lorna's future.

## CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS

**[Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gus](../character/gus.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Kit](../character/kit.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — Following the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory in the election, [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to share the news and discuss politics. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes to the Point, where she unknowingly speaks with a newly clean-shaven [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md). She then spends time with [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), who contemplates his mortality, asks her to care for his cat Matey when he dies, and listens to her recite a poem by Tennyson.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P6](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P24](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P26](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P39](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0039)_

## CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES

**[Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Kit](../character/kit.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh discuss recent news about old acquaintances before [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) arrives with bad news about her sister's broken leg, prompting [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) to temporarily move in. Miss Winifred approves of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) staying with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) while [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) visits. Adrian later arrives, unsettling [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reassures her that Adrian has come for her and that happiness lies ahead.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P19](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P25](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P27](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P49](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0049)_

## CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT

**[Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md), Conservative, Crawfords, Grit, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), Kerrs, MacAllisters, Methodist, [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Presbyterian, [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md) visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh to announce her upcoming marriage to [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md). They discuss his character, religion, political affiliation, and details about the wedding attire while exchanging playful advice.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P4](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P8](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P20](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0020), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P26](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0026)_

## CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES

**[Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md), [Ambrose](../character/ambrose.md), [Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md)** — In the garden, [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) declare their love for one another. They join [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Hugh, and Captain Saul inside by the hearth, where Captain Saul offers a heartfelt blessing over the couples before taking his leave. After Captain Saul and Adrian depart, [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) talk warmly about Lorna's future until [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) returns to the house with local gossip.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P11](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P15](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P35](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0035)_

## CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN SAUL CROSSES THE BAR

**[Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) deliver [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) and [James](../character/james-a.md) Garrick's finished book to Captain Saul, who celebrates its arrival with tea and cake. The next morning, Hugh notices that the lighthouse light is still burning past sunrise. Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) hasten to the lighthouse, where they find Captain Saul has peacefully passed away with his life-book open on his chest.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN SAUL CROSSES THE BAR P4](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN SAUL CROSSES THE BAR P12](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN SAUL CROSSES THE BAR P16](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN SAUL CROSSES THE BAR P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028)_

## CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

**[Carrow](../character/carrow.md), [Kit](../character/kit.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md)** — Hugh proposes buying the [Varley](../character/varley.md) property in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) to give their growing family more room and better access for his medical work. Though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) initially grieves leaving their beloved home of dreams, she comes to accept the move, especially after [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) shares that Adrian plans to buy the old cottage for their summer holidays.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P17](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P35](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P37](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P56](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0056)_

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Kit](../character/kit.md), [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) transition Little Kit into short clothes, and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) shares news that Adrian plans to buy the house for summer holidays. When moving day arrives in October, the house is packed up and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) tearfully says a final goodbye to her beloved home before departing with Hugh.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P53](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0053), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P56](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0056), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P58](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0058), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P65](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0065)_
